svg.title: Sustained proxy performance over a variable Internet path
svg.desc: Five implementations · 40 s bulk download + persistent application echo Line: pointwise median; band: measured min–max. Missing echo attempts remain gaps; clipped outliers keep exact hover values. Unavailable echo attempts are gaps, never zero-latency samples.
